title: USGS ShakeAlert
description: Documented public earthquake early warning (USGS) for the Disaster Early Warning Engine capability area.
body:
USGS ShakeAlert is a documented earthquake early warning from USGS. The West Coast earthquake early-warning system delivering seconds of warning before shaking via WEA and apps.

How it works: It works by fusing the weighted sensor readings into one value and raising a warning when it crosses the threshold.

Documented uses of this capability area include city digital twins, power-grid planning, water-network operations, epidemic modeling, and disaster early warning.
